description: Create a temporary webhook capture endpoint in the agent sandbox (no account needed): up to 3 endpoints at a time, 25 captured requests each and 100 in all, deleted 24 hours after the sandbox was created. The first call registers the sandbox, which takes a few seconds of proof of work. Mock responses, notifications and signature verification need an account: see connect_account.

ephemeral.description: Create a temporary endpoint that auto-expires

expiresIn.description: Auto-expire after this duration, for example "12h"

mockResponse.description: Optional mock response to return when the endpoint receives a request

body.description: Response body (default: empty). {{ placeholders }} are filled in from the request: {{ json.id }} (a JSON or form body field), {{ body }}, {{ headers.user-agent }}, {{ query.page }}, {{ method }}, {{ path }}, {{ id }}, {{ uuid }}, {{ now }}; filters: | default: "x", | json, | lower, | upper, | truncate: 80

delay.description: Response delay in milliseconds (0-30000, default: none)

headers.description: Response headers (default: none); values may use {{ placeholders }} too

notificationUrl.description: URL to POST a JSON summary to after each captured request (e.g. Slack/Discord webhook)

responseRules.description: Conditional response rules. Each rule has conditions and a response. First matching rule wins.

field.description: What to read: method, path, header (name), query (name), body (text), body_path (path into a JSON or form body), content_type, size

name.description: Header or query parameter name; the email part; spf, dkim or dmarc

op.description: eq, neq, contains, not_contains, starts_with, ends_with, matches (glob: * one path segment, ** any, ? one character), regex (RE2, searched anywhere; (?i) ignores case), exists, not_exists, gt, gte, lt, lte (numbers)

path.description: Dot path for body_path, e.g. data.object.status or items.0.sku or a["odd.key"]

value.description: What to compare with (not for exists and not_exists)

logic.description: How to combine conditions: "and" (all match) or "or" (any match)

body.description: Response body (default: empty). {{ placeholders }} are filled in from the request: {{ json.id }} (a JSON or form body field), {{ body }}, {{ headers.user-agent }}, {{ query.page }}, {{ method }}, {{ path }}, {{ id }}, {{ uuid }}, {{ now }}; filters: | default: "x", | json, | lower, | upper, | truncate: 80

delay.description: Response delay in milliseconds (0-30000, default: none)

headers.description: Response headers (default: none); values may use {{ placeholders }} too

signingHeader.description: Custom signature header name. Only used with generic-hmac provider.

signingProvider.description: Signing provider for automatic signature verification (e.g. stripe, github, shopify)

signingSecret.description: Signing secret (encrypted server-side, never returned). Required when signingProvider is set.

name: create_endpoint
